newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Ingosstrakh waits for official crash report.
newsitem.headline: Russia Ingosstrakh waits for official crash report.

text.p: Russia's SAO Ingosstrakh said on Monday it had insured a plane that crashed before the start of the Moscow airshow for $1 million and was waiting to see an official report on the incident.
"We shall be waiting for a report of a state commission to decide what is to be done," an official for Russia's second-biggest insurer told Reuters.
He said it could take the commission two or more weeks to prepare the report.
A BE-103 light transport plane belonging to the Taganrog design bureau crashed during a training flight near the town of Zhukovsky on Monday, killing its pilot.
Another Ingosstrakh official said the pilot was also insured against accidents, but declined to reveal the amount of cover.
The flight was part of preparations for the show in the Zhukovsky area near Moscow, which President Boris Yeltsin was due to open on Tuesday.
